    The graded algebra 𝒪P and its reduction #

    For a ray table P with a degree function on the rays, the linearization 𝒪P over any commutative ring is graded by the degrees of the rays (galgLin), and reduction of coefficients along a ring map is a ring map 𝒪P → kP (redLin). This is the algebra A^{(4)} = 𝒪P of that paper.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
